name: Móvil: la plantilla de artículo declara estructura responsive
description: La plantilla de un artículo incluye viewport responsivo, imagen destacada que escala al ancho del contenedor y sin desbordamiento horizontal de la página. Verificación estructural independiente del ancho del viewport.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Mantenimiento de hardware article page
The article page declares a responsive viewport meta tag (name='viewport' with width=device-width)
The article shows its heading 'Mantenimiento de hardware' and the same site header with hamburger and theme toggle present in the DOM
The featured figure image is constrained to the container width (CSS max-width: 100% / width: 100%) so it never overflows on narrow screens
The page root does not force horizontal overflow (no fixed wide layout making the body scroll sideways)
